channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: NCPA Brings India’s Diverse Dance Forms to the Forefront with Mumbai Dance Season 2026
item.description: A month-long celebration at NCPA Mumbai, the Mumbai Dance Season 2026 brings together India’s folk, tribal, and classical dance traditions through performances by distinguished artistes and ensembles.

item.title: IHC Samanvay 2026 Concludes with Focus on Ecology, Heritage, and the Future
item.description: IHC Samanvay 2026 concluded in New Delhi after three days of dialogue and performance, exploring how India’s landscapes shape its languages, cultures and living traditions.

item.title: Shikhar Dhawan Appointed Brand Ambassador of Inaugural Delhi Khel Mahakumbh
item.description: Shikhar Dhawan has been named Brand Ambassador of the inaugural Delhi Khel Mahakumbh, a Government of Delhi initiative focused on promoting grassroots sports and young talent.

item.title: Thomas Cook India and SOTC Travel Sign Strategic MOU with Mauritius Tourism Promotion Authority
item.description: Thomas Cook India and SOTC Travel have signed a strategic MOU with the Mauritius Tourism Promotion Authority to strengthen Mauritius’ presence in the Indian travel market.

item.title: TripStaq Showcases Powerful Hotel Booking Platform at OTM 2026
item.description: TripStaq showcased its B2B hotel booking platform at OTM 2026, engaging global travel trade partners with its scalable, tech-driven solution.

item.title: Carnegie Hall Announces First Indian Music Festival Backed by $10 Million Gift
item.description: Carnegie Hall has announced its first Indian Music Festival, debuting in 2027, made possible by a $10 million gift from Indo-American philanthropist Ila Paliwal and her family foundation.

item.title: Mumbai’s IICT Launches Esports Premier League Backed by AVGC Policy Momentum
item.description: The Indian Institute of Creative Technologies hosted the first IICT Esports Premier League in Mumbai, aligning esports and creative technologies with the government’s push to strengthen India’s Orange Economy.

item.title: Chinmayi, A.R. Ameen and Others to Join A.R. Rahman at Chennai’s Wonderment Tour
item.description: A. R. Rahman’s Wonderment Tour arrives in Chennai on February 14, featuring a diverse lineup of leading singers and promising a memorable Valentine’s Day concert at Jawaharlal Nehru Outdoor Stadium.

item.title: “We Don’t Copy-Paste Formats Across Markets”: Blu Blood on Scaling Live Entertainment
item.description: Blu Blood’s founders share how adaptability, local insight, and operational discipline are powering expansion and the upcoming India launch.

item.title: Aamir Khan Delights Fans With Exhibition Match at World Pickleball League 2026
item.description: Bollywood megastar Aamir Khan thrilled fans at the World Pickleball League 2026 by playing a special exhibition match, adding star power and excitement to a high-voltage semi-final night in Mumbai.
